text: Philipsen seized his final flat-stage opportunity by fighting into the day's breakaway alongside Simmons, outsprinting a five-man lead group to the line while the GC contenders sat tight in the bunch behind. The Belgian's aggression paid dividends for his Tour salvage mission, but the real story unfolded in the convoy: Pogačar's grip tightened as Evenepoel held steady and Del Toro inched closer to second, while Yates—tasked with protecting the yellow jersey's interests—faded visibly, signaling cracks in the UAE team's armor heading into the Alpine finale.
